title: Blackhawks goalie Spencer Knight’s stick gets stuck in boards: ‘A weird thing’
content:
CHICAGO — Spencer Knight always knew it was possible. He had seen it happen to other goalies. But when his own stick got stuck in the boards during the Chicago Blackhawks’ game against the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday, it still was a shock.

“Like, it was stuck, you really don’t know what to do,” Knight said. “It’s kind of a weird thing.”

Knight had gone behind the Blackhawks’ net to stop and retrieve a puck late in the second period. He put his stick down and against the board to halt the puck. He achieved that, but then discovered his stick was jammed into the boards. He attempted to pull it out but couldn’t.

As Knight was working on that, the Jets’ Mark Scheifele came skating in and took the puck from Knight. With no time to decide, Knight abandoned his stick and hurried back to the front of the net. Knight dove in front of the net just as the Jets’ Kyle Connor shot from the top of the right circle. The puck bypassed Knight and the Jets scored.

“It’s never happened to me,” Knight said. “I’ve seen it happen before. That was the first time it ever happened to me.”

Knight wondered if there was a way to ensure it didn’t happen to him again at the United Center.

“Maybe we can see if we can try to make it a little tighter of a hole?” Knight said. “I don’t know. Who knows? It’s all good.” Knight abandoned his stick after it wedged between the boards behind his net, but Winnipeg pounced and scored.
